summary: Avoid redaction notices for absent or null tool payloads

replay.detail: Existing timeline entries are retained; no replay or cleanup is introduced.

schema.detail: No database, event spool or timeline schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or replication rules change.

compatibility.detail: New tool-call and tool-result entries with absent or JSON-null payloads no longer add a separate sensitive-content redaction notice unless other fields are omitted. Their existing redacted placeholder, digest and serialized byte count remain unchanged. Non-null payloads and omitted fields still produce privacy notices.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption is introduced.

manual.detail: No configuration change or cleanup of retained notices is required.

recovery.detail: Older binaries can read the unchanged entry schema; swapping binaries does not remove retained entries.
